purpose: Natural W1L1 hazard-to-death-to-recovery observation paired with the focused static lifecycle closure.

natural_w1l1_observation.input: KBD_right held for 1600 input frames after W1L1 startup

death_state.interpretation: Death is identified by the combined mode/animation/motion state; action word 0x0004 is not unique to death.

recovery_state.interpretation: Recovery restores the indexed spawn position and idle animation; the timer at +0x3e remains 0x03e8 in the first observed recovered callback.

global_lifecycle.transition_gate: DS:89EA is negative during the death hold and zero at the first recovered sample.
global_lifecycle.transition_word: DS:89E6 remained zero in the captured recovery run.

scheduler_membership.observation: The player remains represented in scheduler banks during death and recovery; bank base and append index rotate or duplicate, so append index is not identity.

negative_control.conclusion: This probe did not reach the natural death setter and is not evidence that the death path is absent.

closed: Natural W1L1 death-state and first recovery-state record shapes are captured.
The observed death hold spans sampled frames 1603..1813, with recovery first observed at 1816.
Player scheduler identity remains callback 0x3ff8 plus object offset zero.
Static recovery map/spawn reconstruction and the 1B01 -> 1AAA relocation are closed.
still_open: Exact unsampled death-setter frame and callback ownership between contact and 19E6/199D.
